verdict.rationale: Stripe's payouts docs, which cover Terminal funds settled into the Stripe balance, describe Instant Payouts that can be sent any time, with funds usually arriving within 30 minutes. That covers the 'speed it up' half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows per-payout arrival visibility or a next-day option. missing for 10: per-payout arrival date/status tracking, a next-day payout option, Terminal-specific payout documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see when each payout lands and speed it up (next-day or instant) when I need the cash

citations.quote: With Instant Payouts you can send payouts any time, including weekends and holidays, and funds usually appear in the associated bank account within 30 minutes.
you can accept in-person payments and manage them alongside your online payments in Stripe
